summary: LUREN KARL SKARTVEIT (org. no. 922 356 092) is a sole proprietorship (ENK) based in Kongsvinger, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2019-03-08. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 82.200 (Telefonvakttjenester og telefonsalg); it has 0 registered employees.
